name: Design Private Data Lifecycle
summary: Define a private-data lifecycle with classification, purpose, access, retention, deletion, and verification evidence.
description: Design or review a privacy-aware data lifecycle across collection, classification, processing, access, sharing, retention, deletion, backup, and incident handling. Use when a product or pipeline handles personal, confidential, regulated, or customer-controlled data.
refuses: It does not expose real personal data, secrets, customer exports, or production records in the plan.
It does not claim legal compliance, anonymization, deletion, or consent from design intent alone.
It does not recommend indefinite retention, silent secondary use, cross-tenant access, or a policy exception without accountable approval.
